# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Tetra Loom**, a mobile-first portrait block-placement puzzle inspired by the spatial logic of Tetris. Use an 8x8 board and three offered tetromino-like shards. The player drags fixed, non-rotating shards into legal grid positions, clears full rows or columns, scores 100 per line plus a 50-point cross bonus, receives a fresh tray after all three shards are used, and loses when any remaining shard cannot fit anywhere. Present the loop as an elegant neon geometric loom with minimalist tension, perfect-fit satisfaction, animated procedural thread background, readable portrait HUD, large touch targets, and compact audio/feedback polish. Preserve mechanics exactly; transform world, visual identity, copy, atmosphere, and mobile hierarchy.

Source prompt: Tetris falling-block puzzle. blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Truth
- genre: mobile block-placement puzzle, Tetris-adjacent but not gravity-falling
- objective: drag one of three offered block pieces onto an 8x8 grid, complete full rows or columns, and maximize score before no offered piece fits
- input model: pointer/touch drag on canvas; restart is a native button click/tap
- core loop: spawn three pieces, drag/place legal pieces, clear full rows/columns, score clears, spawn a new tray after all three are used
- fail/friction state: game over occurs when at least one remaining tray piece exists and none can legally fit anywhere on the grid

## Protected Mechanics
- 8x8 board, fixed tetromino-like shapes, three-piece tray, no rotation, snap-to-grid placement, occupancy collision, row/column clearing, scoring 100 per cleared row/column plus 50 cross bonus, game-over fit test, and restart semantics.

## Remix Blueprint
Tetris falling-block puzzle. A Tetris falling-block puzzle game with elegant spatial logic, escalating speed, perfect-fit satisfaction, minimalist tension, endless optimization, and iconic geometric rhythm with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The new surface reframes the same loop as Tetra Loom: a portrait-first geometric rhythm chamber where players optimize placement of luminous shard families. Presentation, HUD language, background, particles, and typography are transformed while the placement puzzle truth is preserved.
